text:
𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗧𝗢𝗡! 🇧🇩

Litton Das hits his 8th Test hundred, his first in South Africa, with a six off Jansen.
Bangladesh 344/6 at the Wanderers; Hridoy made 137 on Day 1.

Can they reach 400? 👇

#SAvBAN #Cricket

𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗗𝗔𝗦 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗔𝗦 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗞! 🇧🇩🔥

👉 Wanderers Test mein Litton Das ne Marco Jansen ko six maarkar 8th Test hundred pura kiya
👉 South Africa mein unka ye pehla Test century hai
👉 Bangladesh 344/6, Hridoy ne Day 1 par 137 banaye the

Kya Bangladesh 400 paar karega? Comment karo 👇
